projects.name: t'au
projects.blurb: Memory-first zero-trust harness: every agent turn gets a goal, evidence, receipt, and a stop condition.
projects.question: Can an agent turn carry its own stop condition?
projects.why: Agents drift when work is unbounded. Tau puts a contract around agent work — memory-first context before action, bounded subagents, goal-locked handoffs, explicit mocked/live proof boundaries — so every turn ends with evidence and a stop condition.

projects.name: battle
projects.blurb: Red/blue exploit evolution in isolated Docker targets, scored by deterministic proof gates.
projects.question: Can evolved exploit code be judged by proof instead of plausibility?
projects.why: Generated exploit code can't be trusted as proof, so Battle treats it as genetic material instead: Red and Blue evolve attacks and defenses in isolated Docker targets while a deterministic Judge — not plausibility — decides exploit success, blocks, and regressions.

projects.name: surf
projects.blurb: Browser transport for agents — authenticated Chrome, element refs, screenshots, proven tab provenance.
projects.question: Can an agent prove which real browser tab actually answered?
projects.why: Browser agents routinely claim answers no tab produced. Surf is the transport-and-proof layer: authenticated Chrome, element refs, and receipts proving which real tab answered. Orchestration is deliberately someone else's job.

projects.name: persona-dream
projects.blurb: Preregistered study: dreams as inspectable intermediates whose certified affect drives the persona’s live voice — emotion tags, tone, identity held stable.
projects.question: Does dreaming help a persona beyond remembering?
projects.why: Built to test one preregistered question: does a dream — an inspectable intermediate, never silently history — give a persistent persona more than plain memory, when its certified affect drives the live Chatterbox voice?

projects.name: extractor
projects.blurb: Zero-choice document extraction: one file in, one truthful result envelope out.
projects.question: Can document extraction hide every knob and still tell the truth?
projects.why: Extraction stacks fail by offering knobs and then lying about results. Extractor removes both: one file in, the route chosen for you, one truthful result envelope out — including a truthful 'blocked' when it can't.

projects.name: dogpile
projects.blurb: Multi-source research with traceable citations and honest used/skipped/degraded provider reporting.
projects.question: Can a research sweep admit which sources it failed to reach?
projects.why: Research agents cite what they found and hide what they missed. Dogpile makes the sweep honest: multi-source search with citations kept and every provider reported as used, skipped, or degraded.

projects.name: watch
projects.blurb: Video into timestamped frames, transcript, and reports — evidence agents can re-query from memory.
projects.question: Can video become timecode-aligned evidence an agent can query later?
projects.why: A video summary can't answer later questions. Watch turns video into timecode-aligned evidence — frames, transcript, scene cues — stored so an agent can ask 'what was on screen at that moment?' weeks later.

projects.name: scillm
projects.blurb: One execution surface for any model — chat, image, batch, tools, agents, receipts.
projects.question: Can provider glue live in one place instead of every skill?
projects.why: Provider glue was metastasizing through every skill. Scillm is the single execution surface — any model, images, batches, tool calls, agent DAGs — normalized once, with proof receipts.

projects.name: debugger
projects.blurb: Real breakpoints and paused-frame state — prove runtime truth before patching.
projects.question: What was true at the moment the bug happened?
projects.why: Agents patch the imagined program instead of the running one. Debugger forces the question 'what was true at the moment the bug happened?' — a real breakpoint and a paused frame before any patch is allowed.

projects.name: sparta explorer
projects.blurb: Space-cyber evidence threads traced to human decisions — relevance never becomes authority.
projects.question: Can AI surface evidence without acquiring approval authority?
projects.why: AI in compliance tends to turn relevance into authority. Sparta Explorer prevents that: evidence threads traced from framework guidance to program evidence to a human decision — candidate coverage never becomes compliance credit.
